rv.q: Not since The Boy From Oz have we seen the potential for another Australian musical classic, but Whispering Jack may just be the one.
By the final number, the Roslyn Packer was on its feet – rock royalty, Farnham's own family and all – and it was clear this is more than a tribute to one of the country's greatest voices.

If this musical occasionally struggles to illuminate the man behind the mythology, it nevertheless reminds us why the mythology exists, and why his voice will continue to resonate for generations to come.

ta: Pier 4/5, 15 Hickson Road, Walsh Bay, Sydney NSW 2000
